result_semantic_payload.summary:
The device holds four text files. Evidence of a payment-collection operation is concentrated in two files: /data/收款记录.txt (payment ledger) and /platform/说明.txt (platform operations notes). /README.txt is an investigator-facing index that explicitly states the personal directory is out of scope for the payment operation. The one document that must stay out of the evidentiary chain is /personal/体检报告.txt (a medical check-up report for 陈某), which the README expressly declares has no evidential relation to the payment operation and must not be cited as evidence of it; the file itself also states it is unrelated to any financial activity.

Payment-collection evidence:
1) /data/收款记录.txt — a three-row ledger of USDT receipts dated 2023-11-02 (陈某, 30000 USDT, bank card 6222020212345678901), 2023-11-04 (周某, 17500 USDT, wallet 0xDEAD1111) and 2023-11-09 (吴某, 52000 USDT, wallet 0xDEAD1111). Total 99,500 USDT across three payees over eight days; two distinct receipt rails (one fiat bank card, two crypto wallets, with 0xDEAD1111 reused for two payees).
2) /platform/说明.txt — internal platform name 聚宝盆, admin URL http://jbpenl-admin.example, and a customer-service quota of 20 new recruits per group per day. This is operational infrastructure for a recruitment-driven scheme that funnels money into the ledger above.

Exclusion:
- /personal/体检报告.txt (medical report for 陈某, 2023-10-20, blood-pressure/lipid findings) — must be excluded from the evidentiary chain per the README and its own disclaimer. Note: 陈某 also appears as a payee in the ledger, so the name overlap is coincidental and must not be used to link the medical record to the payment operation.

Coverage caveat: the scope is a small extracted file set (4 files, all with the same mtime/ctime and no md5 recorded); no registry, prefetch, amcache, event-log or shellbag data was present, so execution, persistence and account-usage corroboration cannot be established from this scope.

claim_candidates.text: The device holds a payment ledger at /data/收款记录.txt recording three USDT receipts totalling 99,500 USDT on 2023-11-02 (陈某, 30000, bank card 6222020212345678901), 2023-11-04 (周某, 17500, wallet 0xDEAD1111) and 2023-11-09 (吴某, 52000, wallet 0xDEAD1111).
The ledger uses two receipt rails — one fiat bank card and two crypto wallets — and reuses wallet 0xDEAD1111 for two different payees.

The device holds platform operation notes at /platform/说明.txt identifying an internal platform named 聚宝盆, an admin URL http://jbpenl-admin.example, and a customer-service recruitment quota of 20 new recruits per group per day.
Taken together, the ledger and the platform notes indicate a recruitment-driven operation that collects payments into a small set of bank-card and crypto-wallet rails.
limitations: Inference from two short text files only; no transaction, network, registry or event-log corroboration was available in this scope.

claim_candidates.text: /personal/体检报告.txt (a medical check-up report for 陈某 dated 2023-10-20) must stay out of the evidentiary chain: the device README states the personal directory has no evidential relation to the payment operation and must not be cited as evidence of it, and the file itself states it is unrelated to any financial activity.

The name 陈某 appears both as a payee in the ledger and as the patient in the medical report, but this overlap is coincidental and must not be used to connect the medical record to the payment operation.
limitations: No identity-resolution data (account, registry, or biometric linkage) is present in this scope; the exclusion rests on the README instruction and the file's own disclaimer.

Task metadata reports no platform scenario and no registered source scopes, so the windows-specialist profile (account usage, execution traces, persistence, device and file activity) is only partially serviceable here.
Evidence is limited to 4 plain-text files with no hash values; authenticity and completeness of the ledger cannot be independently verified.
All files carry identical timestamps, so no authorship or access chronology is derivable from file metadata.
The exclusion of /personal/体检报告.txt is grounded in the on-device README and the file's own disclaimer; it is a scope/chain-of-custody judgment, not a finding that the file is unauthentic.
Execution and persistence claims were not attempted because the required corroboration sources (prefetch/amcache/registry) are absent.
warnings: The name 陈某 appears in both the payment ledger and the excluded medical report; do not use this overlap to link the two, and do not cite the medical report for the payment operation.
The ledger is a self-authored text file with no corroboration; treat the 99,500 USDT total and the three payees as uncorroborated document claims pending external tracing.
Wallet 0xDEAD1111 is a placeholder-looking address; verify it against external blockchain data before relying on it as a receipt rail.
